description: This file defines the ShoppingCartItem class, a core entity representing an item in a shopping cart within an e-commerce system. It includes attributes such as product details, quantity, pricing, audit information, and associations with cart attributes.

classes.name: ShoppingCartItem
classes.description: Entity class representing an item in a shopping cart, including product info, quantity, pricing, and audit details.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section details of this cart item.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section details for this cart item.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier of the cart item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the cart item.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Replaces the set of attributes for the cart item.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the set of attributes associated with this cart item.

methods.name: setItemPrice
methods.description: Sets the final price of this item.

methods.name: getItemPrice
methods.description: Gets the final price of this item.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product in the cart.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Gets the quantity of the product in the cart.

methods.name: getShoppingCart
methods.description: Retrieves the shopping cart to which this item belongs.

methods.name: setShoppingCart
methods.description: Associates this item with a shopping cart.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the product ID associated with this cart item.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Retrieves the product ID for this cart item.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a Product object with this cart item.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the Product object associated with this cart item.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Adds an attribute item to the cart item's attribute set.

methods.name: removeAttributes
methods.description: Removes an attribute item from the cart item's attribute set.

methods.name: removeAllAttributes
methods.description: Removes all attribute items from the cart item.

methods.name: setSubTotal
methods.description: Sets the subtotal price for the cart item.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Retrieves the subtotal price for the cart item.

methods.name: setFinalPrice
methods.description: Sets detailed final price information for the cart item.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Gets detailed final price information for the cart item.

methods.name: isObsolete
methods.description: Checks if the cart item is marked as obsolete.

methods.name: setObsolete
methods.description: Marks the cart item as obsolete or active.

methods.name: isProductVirtual
methods.description: Indicates whether the product is virtual.

methods.name: setProductVirtual
methods.description: Sets whether the product is virtual.
